claim_en: THE SELF-SALE GATE. Only the impoverished; only to you; brother to him, servant to himself; slave's work keyed to status.
THE HIRELING TABLE. Same-day pay; equal fare; craft kept; the household fed on the master's knowledge.
THE RETURN. Not to the former office; the refuge-city exile released by the same verb.
MY DEED FIRST. Prior title bars the slave market.
RIGOR. Needless commands are rigor, judged by the heart clause; Onkelos's one word for rigor and hostility.
THE GENTILE SLAVE. Not the land's Canaanites; no betrothal by likeness to the maidservant.
ACQUISITION. Money, deed, possession imported from land; Onkelos's uncircumcised residents.
INHERITANCE. Sons, presumption; no overreaching; work only; both sexes; rigor by status.
SOLD TO A GENTILE. The four buyers down to the idol; only after the sale; at once; paternal first.
THE LADDER. Uncle, cousin, nearest, self, anyone; the tripled verb generalizes.
THE RECKONING. With the buyer alone; no six-year exit; money only.
THE DEDUCTION. Lesser figure either way; the upper hand transferred by verbal analogy.
THE SIGHT BOUND. Equal fare under a gentile; the duty ends at what you can see.
BY THESE. Two arms crossed; robbing a gentile is robbery with the ladder.
SERVANTS TO ME. The enslaving below charged above.
